response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM status_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.telescope_count, sc.telescope_count::NUMERIC / tc.total as share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM with_shares) SELECT SUM(ws.telescope_count) as total_telescopes_above_avg, AVG(ws.share) as avg_share_above_avg, AVG(ws.share - avg.avg_share_value) as how_far_above_avg FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN avg_share avg WHERE ws.share > avg.avg_share_value
